svg.title: The keep-out filter: what is off limits for the whole plan
svg.desc: Built once per plan request from the initial state, for each footprint class, and stored in PlanContext::keep_out_filter_by_footprint. It names every enabled entity as ignored, so only disabled nodes, disabled entities and whatever stands on a disabled node remain as obstacles.

g.text: Pose entries computed from the cached collision table by scripts/blocked_poses.py; edge entries are not drawn. Grey entities are in the ignore sets, so the filter does not see them. Map labels: P17, W22,

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: B21, C14 = node_id 17, 22, 21, 14 (P parking, W waypoint, B bay, C AGV charger); T17 = tray_id 17; AGV-1 = agv_id 1; X@90 = GaragePose {node_id: X, heading: 90}, heading in degrees [-179, 180], 90 =
